queries.sql: SELECT a.exchange, COUNT(*) AS total_stocks, SUM(CASE WHEN a.liquidity_rank <= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_500_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.liquidity_rank <= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_50_count FROM us_equities.main.assets AS a GROUP BY a.exchange ORDER BY a.exchange;

SELECT a.industry, COUNT(DISTINCT a.asset_id) AS stock_count FROM us_equities.main.assets AS a WHERE a.sector = 'Manufacturing' AND a.liquidity_rank <= 500 GROUP BY a.industry ORDER BY stock_count DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT a.sector, COUNT(*) AS total_stocks, SUM(CASE WHEN a.liquidity_rank <= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_500_stocks FROM us_equities.main.assets a GROUP BY a.sector ORDER BY total_stocks DESC;

SELECT asset_id AS ticker, sic_code, industry FROM us_equities.main.assets WHERE asset_id IN ('BMY','ABBV','PFE','LLY','MRK','JNJ','AZN','ABT','COLB','CRWD') ORDER BY CASE asset_id WHEN 'BMY' THEN 1 WHEN 'ABBV' THEN 2 WHEN 'PFE' THEN 3 WHEN 'LLY' THEN 4 WHEN 'MRK' THEN 5 WHEN 'JNJ' THEN 6 WHEN 'AZN' THEN 7 WHEN 'ABT' THEN 8 WHEN 'COLB' THEN 9 WHEN 'CRWD' THEN 10 ELSE 11 END;

WITH filtered AS ( SELECT a.asset_id, p.total_return_1d, p.trading_date FROM us_equities.main.assets AS a JOIN us_equities.main.daily_prices AS p ON a.asset_id = p.asset_id WHERE a.liquidity_rank <= 500 AND p.trading_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND p.trading_date < DATE '2026-01-01' ) SELECT asset_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN ABS(total_return_1d) > 0.10 THEN 1 END) AS sessions_over_10pct, MAX(total_return_1d) AS largest_rise, MIN(total_return_1d) AS largest_fall FROM filtered GROUP BY asset_id ORDER BY sessions_over_10pct DESC, asset_id LIMIT 10;

WITH returns AS ( SELECT a.asset_id, a.sector, ( SELECT dp.adjusted_close FROM us_equities.main.daily_prices dp WHERE dp.asset_id = a.asset_id AND dp.trading_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-02' AND DATE '2026-03-12' ORDER BY dp.trading_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS end_price, COALESCE( ( SELECT dp.adjusted_close FROM us_equities.main.daily_prices dp WHERE dp.asset_id = a.asset_id AND dp.trading_date < DATE '2026-01-02' ORDER BY dp.trading_date DESC LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT dp.adjusted_close FROM us_equities.main.daily_prices dp WHERE dp.asset_id = a.asset_id AND dp.trading_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-02' AND DATE '2026-03-12' ORDER BY dp.trading_date ASC LIMIT 1 ) ) AS start_price FROM us_equities.main.assets a ) SELECT r.sector, COUNT(r.asset_id) AS stock_count, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.end_price IS NOT NULL AND r.start_price IS NOT NULL THEN (r.end_price / r.start_price) - 1 END) AS median_return FROM returns r GROUP BY r.sector ORDER BY stock_count DESC;

WITH wp AS (SELECT asset_id, trading_date, adjusted_close, total_return_1d FROM us_equities.main.daily_prices WHERE asset_id IN ('BMY','ABBV','PFE') AND trading_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2026-03-12'), endc AS (SELECT asset_id, adjusted_close AS end_close FROM (SELECT asset_id, adjusted_close, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY asset_id ORDER BY trading_date DESC) AS rn FROM wp) sub WHERE rn = 1), basec AS (SELECT asset_id, COALESCE((SELECT dp.adjusted_close FROM us_equities.main.daily_prices dp WHERE dp.asset_id = wp.asset_id AND dp.trading_date < DATE '2025-12-01' ORDER BY dp.trading_date DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT dp.adjusted_close FROM us_equities.main.daily_prices dp WHERE dp.asset_id = wp.asset_id AND dp.trading_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2026-03-12' ORDER BY dp.trading_date ASC LIMIT 1)) AS base_close FROM wp GROUP BY asset_id), stats AS (SELECT asset_id, stddev_samp(total_return_1d) AS daily_volatility FROM wp GROUP BY asset_id) SELECT e.asset_id AS ticker, (e.end_close / b.base_close) - 1 AS total_return, s.daily_volatility FROM endc e JOIN basec b ON e.asset_id = b.asset_id JOIN stats s ON e.asset_id = s.asset_id;
